items.title: Backend & Microservices

items.title: Payments & FinTech

items.title: Cloud & DevOps
items.text: AWS Lambda, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, Docker and Kubernetes, shipped through Azure DevOps, Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines.

items.text: TDD with JUnit and Mockito, resilience patterns like Retry and Circuit Breaker, and root-cause driven production support.

jobs.summary: A payment systems platform for enterprise financial clients covering payment processing, transaction routing, receipting, reconciliation and cash-flow management.
highlights: Built the platform as independently deployable microservices communicating over REST and AWS SQS/SNS, so one payment flow could be released without redeploying the rest.
Integrated payment gateways, DebiCheck and AVS verification over secure REST APIs, automating end-to-end payment validation.
Applied Retry, Circuit Breaker and Rate Limiter patterns so a failing downstream provider degrades the workflow instead of stopping it.
Built event-driven orchestration on AWS Step Functions and Lambda, containerised with Docker for Kubernetes.
Secured financial data with JWT, role-based access control and AWS Secrets Manager.

jobs.summary: An enterprise risk-analysis platform surfacing application vulnerabilities through static and dynamic code analysis, with remediation tracking and compliance reporting.
highlights: Extended the Java and Spring Boot layer over MySQL with new features, without disrupting existing consumers.
Designed the schemas and queries behind risk scoring and reporting, keeping output accurate and responsive under load.
Secured vulnerability and compliance data with Spring Security and JWT.
Drove quality with JUnit and Mockito suites, peer review and CI/CD on Git, Maven and Jenkins.

jobs.summary: A centralised operations platform integrating GE Digital's Historian and iFIX products to collect, process and visualise industrial data.
highlights: Developed backend features in Java, Spring Boot, JPA and Hibernate for industrial data processing and reporting.
Wrote and tested the MySQL queries powering the monitoring dashboards used by manufacturing teams.
Supported integration of GE Historian and iFIX systems for real-time data collection.
